_note: The editor's decisions on finder 705's seller pages after verifier 706 opened every one (all 115 confirmed as pages). A link stays on a drug's page only if a person can buy there a test for that drug, or for the danger the site's own checked lines name on that page (fentanyl in pills sold as benzodiazepines or as pain medicines; fentanyl, xylazine and nitazenes in heroin). Labels say in plain English what is sold, from what the verifier saw on the page; the seller's own label is kept as label_seen. Stock is not tracked: three pages showed 'out of stock' or 'sold out' when read (Reagent Tests UK fentanyl strip; NUAA cocaine and MDMA kits) and stay, as stock changes.

drop.why: No seller page names methadone or buprenorphine (verifier 706), and a fentanyl strip is not a test of them: the site's own checked lines list no validated home test for these medicines and record a fentanyl strip showing positive on a sample that held only buprenorphine. A link here would promise a test that does not exist.
